lines.say: Everyone on floor nine is dead. They still pay rent.
Three oh seven. The lights on floor nine come on. Every night.
You moved in because it was cheap. One dollar a month.
Then you find the rent book. Died nineteen ninety four. Paid.
Behind you, a door opens. They can't cancel. Nobody can.
Your phone buzzes. Lease renewed. Forever.
Would you stay? Write it in the comments.
